verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers M5's AI/ML acceleration, GPU, Metal APIs, and general hardware specs, but contains no mention of virtualization support, hypervisor frameworks (e.g. Apple Hypervisor.framework, Parallels, UTM, VMware Fusion), or Docker/container workflows on M5. Missing for 10: documented virtualization framework support, hypervisor compatibility claims, Docker Desktop/container runtime performance data, and any developer or community confirmation of VM/container workflows on M5 silicon.
